stage2_real_config.framework_stage: Stage 2 final: Option 1 identifiability conclusion plus Option 2 exploratory real-data sensitivity
stage2_real_config.purpose: Estimate assumption-dependent effective delayed-feedback parameters from real A11 and A13 skeleton falls and compare prospective held-out CoM paths without claiming physiological controller identification.

interpretation.parameters: effective and assumption-dependent; not physiological measurements
interpretation.held_out_policy: held-out CoM samples are not used in parameter or shared-pulse fitting
interpretation.selection_policy: the displayed central model selects zero versus shared-pulse forcing by training-only AIC; held-out samples are excluded
interpretation.known_limitation: no measured perturbation torque, force plate, ground-reaction force, center of pressure, or recovery-force data
